native_protocol.input: PIL RGB bilinear resize to checkpoint input size, original ImageNet normalization
native_protocol.prediction: mean logits then softmax on model grid; FP32 bilinear probabilities to untouched native mask shape, align_corners=false; argmax after resize
native_protocol.ground_truth: Unchanged original pixel indices including255; no GT resizing or morphology
native_protocol.reference: Re-evaluate original A0 with this exact native protocol before training and freeze gates: stone Dice>=A0, fiber Dice>=A0-0.01, negative FP area<=A0
native_protocol.primary_selection: Fixed final epoch15 on native grid; per-epoch native gates used for diagnostic selection and existing collapse stop; do not compare old model-grid numbers
native_protocol.small_target_scope: Whole-frame visible stone area, not annotated instances; new native-grid bins, distinct from old<=128 model-grid group

training: Original U-Net, ImageNet encoder+random decoder; no surgical checkpoint warmstart; same190 labels, class_weights1/2/4, loss, batch2, lr1e-4, cosine15, uniform sampling and1425 updates per arm
budget_scope: Equal optimizer updates2850image exposures per arm;512 has4x input pixels and different hardware cost, not compute-matched

performance.input: cached native BGR via OpenCV model-grid preprocessing, plus same native probability output resize; excludes decoding, display, geometry and memory

source_resolution_note: Both videos native400x400;512 input upsamples the original and does not create optical detail;256 discards some original sampling detail
constraints: Kidney190 supervised only, stone_new banned, reserve800 not read, both videos and derivatives validation-only, source labels and case provenance provisional
stop_policy: Frozen existing foreground-collapse checks on native GT; no automatic extension; aborted or AMP-skipped-update arm cannot be called equal-budget
